title: Thule Society founder initiated in Kurdistan

tellings.quote: >> And the Thu Society, oddly enough, it was founded by this guy, Baron Rudolfph von Spottenorf, >> who was initiated in Kurdistan of all places.

plain: The Thule Society, a German secret society, was founded by a man who had been initiated into esoteric teachings in Kurdistan, according to the researcher Jason Jorjani. Jorjani tells Michels that the founder, Baron Rudolf von Sebottendorf, was initiated there "of all places", and he mentions the occult writer Helena Blavatsky alongside him without naming a source. It comes up in a conversation about the roots of what Jorjani calls Hitler's secret UFO program, and if true it would tie that German circle to older Eastern initiations.
